name: quetrex
description: The Quetrex agentic build system: a stack-agnostic pipeline engine plus per-language add-on packs. Every quality/security/process guarantee is enforced by a deterministic hook reading an on-disk artifact, never by agent prose. Private marketplace — github.com/Glori-Holdings/quetrex-plugins.

plugins.name: quetrex-factory
plugins.description: Stack-agnostic engine: architect -> developer(s) -> QA -> reviewer -> security-reviewer -> git-workflow, with a right-size router, bounded self-heal loops, and hook-enforced merge gates. verify-gate blocks 'done' while typecheck/lint/build/tests are red; the security-reviewer OWASP checklist hard-blocks on any Critical.
